demo.title: teslr.sh
demo.code:
# List your connected Teslas
bankr prompt "Use Teslr to list my vehicles"

# Check live vehicle data
bankr prompt "Use Teslr to check all four tire pressures"

# Run a vehicle command
bankr prompt "Use Teslr to warm my Tesla to 72 degrees"

# Find and send a nearby destination
bankr prompt "Use Teslr to navigate to the nearest Safeway"

setup: Connect directly at https://teslr.club, then save the one-time token as TESLR_FLEET_TOKEN in Bankr Terminal -> Settings -> Env Vars
For direct vehicle commands, approve the Teslr virtual key for each vehicle in the Tesla app
Existing Tessie users may instead add TESSIE_API_TOKEN in Bankr Env Vars; the skill prefers Tessie when both tokens exist
Keep tokens private: never paste them into a prompt, chat, or public X post
